column1: # Offered load for examples/dual-plane.dc, for "load the cables".
# Each line is one flow: the target sends to its peer, at that many Gb/s.
#   R01 -> R03   every server in rack R01 sends 40 Gb/s to its namesake in
#                R03, in the other pod: 20 Gb/s down each of its two NICs,
#                80% of their 25G, and 80% of R01's four 100G uplinks too
#   R04 -> R02   all eight servers in R04 send 10 Gb/s to one server, R02/s5:
#                an incast of 80 Gb/s into two 25G NICs, 160% of what they
#                can take -- the cables past 100% are their own colour
#   R02          s1 sends to s2, in its own rack: it never leaves the ToRs
